verdict.rationale: The pack documents no product-level bulk operations, such as batch-creating, updating, deleting or launching actions across many agents, calls or contacts at once. The adjacent evidence does not qualify for this story. Batch testing of graded test cases is a testing feature, per-agent data retention is an automatic deletion policy, and the 25-file voice-clone upload and Conductor's conversation filtering are not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
